title: The Stag in the Ox Stall
summary: A hunted stag hid beneath the straw in an ox-stall. The oxen promised silence. Grooms, laborers, and the bailiff entered and left without noticing him....
keywords: the stag in the ox stall
full_text:
A hunted stag hid beneath the straw in an ox-stall. The oxen promised silence. Grooms, laborers, and the bailiff entered and left without noticing him.

Then the master came to inspect the stall. Seeing unusual mounds of straw, he poked his stick, discovered the antlers, and captured the stag.
moral: The master’s eye sees what the eyes of the servants overlook.
